_readme: Global site config. Anything null/TBD must be filled by officers; render visible placeholders until then.
name: Snider Consulting Group
description: SCG is the University of Maryland's student-run consulting group. Students from every major solve real problems for real clients, with mentorship from EY.
established_at: Robert H. Smith School of Business, University of Maryland

recruiting.banner_text: Interest form is open. All UMD majors welcome.
recruiting.note: Set 'open' to true and fill the URLs when the cycle is live. When false, the site shows 'closed_text' and the interest form link if present.

images._readme: Paths are relative to the repo root. Anything under assets/placeholders/ is treated as a placeholder and drawn as a labeled gray block. 'hero' currently points at the old group photo as a stand-in; set 'hero_is_standin' to false once a candid, varied photo replaces it.
images.hero_alt: SCG members in business attire standing in front of the Robert H. Smith School of Business sign.

timeline._readme: Recruitment timeline steps. Dates are unknown; render 'Dates TBD' until filled. Step names are suggestions modeled on a clear step-by-step pattern; officers must confirm which steps actually exist.

steps.name: Interest form
steps.description: Tell us who you are. Takes five minutes.

press.blurb: Read what the Smith School says about SCG.

press.label: The Diamondback
press.blurb: Read about SCG in UMD's student newspaper.

press.label: Ed Snider Center
press.blurb: Learn about SCG and its benefactor.

partners.name: EY
partners.blurb: EY sends consultants to lead workshops, pairs each project with consultants, senior managers and partners, and connects members to EY recruiters. SCG has partnered with EY for over four years.

partners.name: Center for Social Value Creation
partners.blurb: Each year SCG collaborates with the Center for Social Value Creation to host the Smith Impact Case Competition. The winning team earns a cash prize and represents UMD at the Seattle Milgard Invitational Case Competition.

partners.name: Ed Snider Center for Enterprise and Markets
partners.blurb: SCG operates in direct affiliation with the Ed Snider Center and is funded by its generous support and by alumni.
